title: 第5章 刀锋无情四座皆惊第6章 天罡剑宗我一定会去
lines: 你……滚下来！”
冰冷的几个字入耳，场上的氛围，再度加剧。
萧诺竟然不满足击败萧乘，而是把矛头对准了萧家的少主……萧永。
萧永的眼神变得森寒无比，他双手握拳，杀意燃动。
“你这个可恶贱东西，你也配挑战我！”
“是我不配？还是你……不敢？”
萧诺语带嘲讽，嚣狂霸气。
看着此刻的嚣狂，场下不少人都露出了丝丝惊疑。
这就是曾经的晰月城第一天才吗？
虽然三年前失去了天凰血，但今日风采再现。
萧永也是彻底被激怒了：“你在说什么梦话，上台……来战！
不过丑话说在前面，生死，各安天命！”
今天可是萧永意气风发的时刻，他岂能任由萧诺践踏自己颜面。
一见这种情况，台上的其他人纷纷退下。
萧雨薇看着眼前这一幕，也知道今天不可能善了。
她眼中闪过一抹幽光，趁着台上几人下来的空档，然后走到了台边。
“这个拿好……”
萧雨薇侧着身子，把一枚丹药悄悄塞到萧永的手中。
萧永不解：“这是什么？”
“兽力丹，服用之后，能够爆发双倍的力量，你拿着，以备不时之需。”
说完，萧雨薇就走开了。
萧永暗自冷笑，以自己炼体境七重的实力，解决掉一个萧诺，完全就是轻而易举的事情。
虽然对方打败了萧乘，但绝不是自己的对手。
不过有了这枚兽力丹，萧永的底气更澎湃了。
看着上台的萧诺，萧永杀心已起。
“我保证，今天你走不出这萧家大门……”
两眼一红，萧永当即取出一柄锋芒闪烁的弯刀。
弯刀在手，萧永有如奔狼般踏了出去，施展的正是萧家的高等武学《狼形刀法》。
“受死吧！”
“狼奔千里！”
萧永速度极快，瞬间欺身至萧诺的面前。
殊不知，萧诺早已对《狼形刀法》了若指掌，面对萧永挥斩而来的弯刀，萧诺身形一侧，轻而易举的避开了对方的强攻。
接着，萧诺左手朝上一甩，准确的打在了萧永的手腕处。
萧永顿觉手臂一麻，手中的弯刀竟是脱手飞出。
什么？
content_en:
You...get off! "
After hearing these cold words, the atmosphere on the field intensified again.
Xiao Nuo was not satisfied with defeating Xiao Cheng, but instead targeted the young master of the Xiao family... Xiao Yong.
Xiao Yong's eyes became extremely cold, and he clenched his fists with murderous intent.
"You hateful bitch, you are worthy of challenging me! "
"Am I not worthy? Or do you... don't dare? "
Xiao Nuo's words were sarcastic and arrogant.
Seeing the commotion at this moment, many people in the audience showed a trace of surprise.
Is this the former number one genius in Xiyue City?
Although he lost the blood of Tianhuang three years ago, his style is restored today.
Xiao Yong was also completely irritated: "What are you talking about in your sleep? Come on stage... and fight!"
But the ugly words are ahead, life and death, everyone is determined by their destiny! "
Today was Xiao Yong's moment of high spirits, how could he let Xiao Nuo trample on his face.
Seeing this, everyone else on the stage stepped back.
Xiao Yuwei looked at the scene in front of her and knew that it was impossible to be kind today.
There was a glint in her eyes, and she took advantage of the opportunity when several people came down from the stage, and then walked to the edge of the stage.
"Take this..."
Xiao Yuwei turned sideways and quietly pushed a pill into Xiao Yong's hand.
Xiao Yongjie: "What is this? "
"The Beast Power Pill, after taking it, can explode with double the power. You should hold it in case of emergency. "
After saying that, Xiao Yuwei walked away.
Xiao Yong sneered secretly. With his seventh level of body refining realm, it was completely easy to kill Xiao Nuo.
Although the other party defeated Xiao Cheng, he was by no means his opponent.
However, with this beast power pill, Xiao Yong's confidence became even stronger.
Looking at Xiao Nuo on stage, Xiao Yong was already murderous.
"I promise, you won't be able to walk out of the Xiao family's door today..."
His eyes turned red, and Xiao Yong immediately took out a scimitar with a shining edge.
"Qiang! "
With the scimitar in hand, Xiao Yong stepped out like a running wolf, using the Xiao family's advanced martial arts "Wolf Shaped Sword Technique".
"Suffer death! "
“The wolf runs a thousand miles! "
"Ugh! "
Xiao Yong was extremely fast, and he was in front of Xiao Nuo in an instant.
As everyone knows, Xiao Nuo already knows the "Wolf Shaped Sword Technique" well. Facing Xiao Yong's scimitar, Xiao Nuo turned to one side and easily avoided the opponent's attack.
Then, Xiao Nuo swung his left hand upwards and accurately hit Xiao Yong's wrist.
“Ta! "
Xiao Yong suddenly felt his arm go numb, and the scimitar in his hand flew out.
What?
